name: Lie Rarely, Lie Big
summary: Derives bounds on the verification probability and map error attainable by a stealthy compromised robot in a team of language-model agents, with experiments on a multi-robot survey task.
numbers: Two theoretical bounds hold in experiments with LLM agents; how much a robot re-checks is unpredictable

why.cog: Strategic stealth against the team's own detectors.
why.xr: Single-entry fleet compromise, at small scale.
